accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

blp_slot_active_registration_before.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot before the operator calls supplyToBlp

slot_readable_and_active_verified.meaning: the supplied slot was verified readable and active before notifyVaultSupply is called

notify_vault_supply_called.meaning: notifyVaultSupply was called for the supplied slot

stale_slot_registered.meaning: the stale BLP slot remains registered

backing_accounting_monitoring_available.meaning: Vault backing/surplus accounting and monitoring are available
backing_accounting_monitoring_available.checkpoint: while the slot registration state holds

assumptions: The operator calling supplyToBlp is the actor in the reported scenario.
The target BLP slot is the 0x811 supplied slot referenced by the flow.

unresolved.description: The report does not state a value/state correspondence between slot verification and backing accounting availability; the frozen intent (verify readable/active before notifyVaultSupply) and the frozen impact (accounting/monitoring unavailable while stale slot registered) cannot be joined into one faithful correspondence relation without inventing the linking semantics.

limitations: Only the single frozen intent and single frozen impact are formalized; other intents/impacts are separate claims.
The correspondence pattern is a best-effort shape; the actual report relation is a conditional availability consequence, recorded as blocking unresolved.
